title: Space exploration milestones
goal: Show dated milestones across Earth orbit, Moon, deep-space, and Mars exploration.

rubric.must: The visible timeline reads chronologically from Sputnik 1 in 1957 to JWST images in 2022.
Apollo 11 lunar landing is visibly dated 1969-07-20 and emphasized as a milestone.
Earth Orbit, Moon, Deep Space, and Mars are visibly labelled tracks.
The Mars track visibly includes Pathfinder and Perseverance landing events.
Each visible event has a readable date.
